summary: Rocket Lab Corp filed an 8-K disclosing a prospectus supplement for the resale of 2,277,002 shares of common stock issued in a private placement related to the acquisition of Mynaric AG. The filing is a routine registration of shares for resale by selling stockholders under an existing S-3ASR shelf registration, not a standalone special situation. No new transaction terms, premium, or deal structure are announced. The filing includes a legal opinion from Goodwin Procter LLP. This is a procedural filing to fulfill registration obligations under a stock purchase agreement, with no independent event-driven catalyst.
